name: Kevin R. Cahill
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Denver, Colorado
education: University of Denver Sturm College of Law
about: Kevin Rhodes Cahill is a judicious advocate for his clients, helping them overcome serious legal challenges related to criminal law, ranging from federal crimes, juvenile crimes, DUI/DWIs, and domestic violence, to credit card fraud and insurance fraud. From the Law Office of Kevin Cahill in Denver, Colorado, he serves residents across the surrounding region, as well as throughout the state.

With over 15 years of experience, Mr. Cahill understands the intense emotions that are at play when facing a serious criminal allegation, and he fights tooth and nail to get his clients the respite they need to move forward with their lives. For his many contributions, he has been included in the Top 40 Under 40 and Top 100 lists by the National Trial Lawyers Association, and he has been rated a perfect “10” on Avvo, along with hosting many positive client testimonials on the site as well.

Mr. Cahill completed his undergraduate studies in 2001, graduating with his Bachelor of Arts degree from Wake Forest University. He then went on to attend the University of Denver Sturm College of Law, where he bolstered his legal acumen and talents to help his clients today. He received his Juris Doctor in 2005, and three years later, he became licensed to practice law in Colorado.

Outside his law practice, Mr. Cahill holds close affiliations with many legal organizations, including the National College for DUI Defense, the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, the American Institute of DUI/DWI Attorneys, the Colorado Criminal Defense Bar, the Colorado Bar Association and the Denver Bar Association.
